notes.title: Brick Buddies Demo and Developer Livestream now on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The Demo of Brick Buddies is now available!
Get ready to team up with your best bud and embark on a wobbly construction adventure. Dive into the demo during the Steam Next Fest and start building epic structures together! Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist and brace yourselves for some serious buddy bonding.

Join the Devs in the Livestream now!
If your buddy's busy, fear not! Join us for a hilarious evening of construction chaos. 
Learn some tips and tricks to conquer those mischievous sheep and build friendships that last!

Stay Connected with us!
Can't get enough of the chaos? Follow us to stay updated on all things Brick Buddies! 
Brick Buddies Social Media
